WITH phase_stats AS (
  SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes AS t
  INNER JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
), phase_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) AS mean_bandwidth
  FROM phase_stats
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_bandwidth), SUM(p.telescope_count), AVG(p.avg_bandwidth - m.mean_bandwidth)
FROM phase_stats AS p
CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m
WHERE p.avg_bandwidth > m.mean_bandwidth;
